DANGEROUS DOORMEN

By: Sian Clark | Delivery

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
DANGEROUS DOORMEN

Summary:
Deaths by bouncers - unnecessary and horrific. They should go through training. When does one intervene? Do steroids play a major role?

Further information:
In the week that SA released it's crime stats and announced that murder was up by 4.9% a young 23 year old was stabbed and kicked in the head by a bouncer at a Pretoria nightclub. His traumatised brother witnessed the attack and recorded it.

The family hired a private investigator to track down the bouncer in the cell phone footage and he did. The private investigator will speak to us. He knows a great deal about the case including that there were two bouncers involved. The first bouncer stabbed Shane and the second bouncer kicked him in the head. His death certificate says he died from a head wound. The bouncer who stabbed him is still at large. We may be able to use photographs of the bouncer. This happened in the car park of the Menlyn Square Shopping Centre outside the club. I am still waiting for an opening to talk to the family as it has only been a few days but the PI all take me to visit the father. We are also hoping to get witnesses and a statement from the police. The patrons told the venue to lock the place down but the venue refused. The police also asked patrons not to make trouble for Tys Nightclub.

This is the third incident in a month at this nightclub. There has been an attempted rape and an assault in the last three weeks. There is a chance that the other two victims will speak on camera but will be disguised. The owner of the nightclub hires huge guys to act as bouncers but they have no training or background checks done. The Private Investigator will speak about these other cases and is trying to persuade the other two victims to come on camera albeit anonymously.


A month ago a young father was killed in a bar in Krugersdorp. Cell phone footage shows the drunk patron being taken outside by the bouncer and around the corner of the pub. The bouncer returns but the patron is lying dead.
The owner of the bar says the bouncer was just doing his job. Patrons say that the police did not take any statements and asked witnesses to go home and let them do their job.

One of my experts is a A former bouncer and nightclub owner for 18 years says that there are two sides to the story. Patrons often get drunk or are taking drugs and often the bouncer is the last resort to intervene. But he says it is out of control now and that steroids are playing a bigger role than normal..He says it is used to be really hard to get them but now they are being sold in many gyms. He promises that if we promise to protect his anonymity he will spill the beans about the bouncer situation in JHB and Pretoria.

I am waiting to confirm a specialist who will speak about what the side effects of these steroids are.

I have not yet contacted Mike Bolhuis - I am unsure if I need him at this stage.

Press Release:


Dangerous Doormen
When Shane Boruchowitz tried to stop a fight between his brother, friends and other patrons at a popular Pretoria nightclub, a bouncer intervened and allegedly stabbed him in the chest. The young man died tragically after the violent scuffle. His traumatised brother stood by helpless, unable to stop the attack. What happens when bouncers - meant to deter violence - turn into dangerous doormen? Carte Blanche investigates.


Script:


CARTE BLANCHE DANGEROUS DOORMEN
VOICE: DEVI WEDNESDAY 25TH NOVEMBER
TX: 10TH JANUARY 2015
FINAL SCRIPT VERSION: 25TH November.
SCRIPTWRITER SIAN CLARK


VOICE: So you visit a bar or night club to chill, be seen or be entertained. Whatever your reasons most patrons are secure in the knowledge that if trouble breaks out – there are usually bouncers on hand to diffuse a situation. But what happens when things go wrong and these bouncers become Dangerous Doormen.

KARISKA 00_0002_2015-10-09_121538
00.00.12 EVERYONE HAS A RIGHT TO LET OFF STEAM .. relax you should be safe … not worried you going to get beaten up by a bouncer 00.00.28


FROM EXTRA BOUNCERS CLIP
UP SOUND: GENE KOTTON 00.49.18 AT END OF DAY 00.44.50 even if you make trouble … hit somebody them and hit first should be in a morgue 00.44.
58

UP SOUND JACQUI
“who on earth wants to hear that their son is dead .. no mother” .

DEVI LINK outside ty’s In the past few months there has been utter disbelief at the excessive use of force by some Bouncers in nightclubs.
Some of these cases have ended in death.

VOICE:
Jacqui BARKAKOVITZ lost her 22 year old son Shane in September. He had visited Ty’s night club in Menlyn, Pretoria around 10pm. Two hours later Shane was dead.

UP SOUND: MOTHER
00.02.16 I got to Pretoria … I saw this bag … which was shane .. 02.23


UP SOUND JACKIE
00.01.12 its not true, you want to believe that it’s not true because it’s your beautiful son, it’s your beautiful son that you brought into the world.

UP SOUND: GENE 00.36.06
he was stabbed by one bouncer and then attacked by another bouncer with vicious blows. ….

VOICE

Gene Kotton is a private investigator and a family friend of Shane Boruchowitz. He assisted them in the crucial 24 hours after the killing.

UP SOUND: 00.35.41 the brother ran across the road away from scene cos he was scared he and hid under the car and they ALSO chased him cos they wanted to kill him crazy for having a fight 00.36.58

DEVI LINK
Ty’s nightclub responded to a request for an interview by sending a written statement.
To the extent that allegations are made that we as a club are responsible, this is both unfair and baseless.

The incident of the unfortunate passing of Shane Barakowitz did not take place in our premises.
The incident took place in the parking lot of the Menlyn Piazza.



VOICE:
The incident, as they call it, was the death of Shane Barakowtiz.

Carte Blanche has seen the statement made to the police. A witness refers to a person hitting Shane’s head - “using it as a punching bag”.

GENE tracked down the person responsible and handed the information over to the police. Bouncer Okwoochwooku Joshua Nywiro is a foreign National. He was arrested and is out on bail.

The second bouncer who allegedly stabbed Shane is still on the run.

Tys nightclub responded by saying:

DEVI LINK:
they employ staff members to detect and diffuse any potential physical altercation in their premises and to escort unruly patrons off the premises.
But they also admit that their staff members are not trained, authorized or instructed to use any violence or assault anyone, particularly Ty’s patrons.
UP SOUND: JACKIE
00.08.18 that person has taken my grandchildren away from me ..
…. this person WHOEVER IT IS has taken his life … how dare he 00.14.52.

VOICE
Across town another young mother is grieving. Krugersdorp resident Kariska Eksteen recently buried the father of her two small children. Her childhood sweetheart - Allen Eksteen went out for drinks on Saturday August 29th and didn’t return home.

UP SOUND: KARISKA EKSTEEN
00.0012 they phoned me five o clock morning .. he said he is very sorry to do this over the phone .. but my husband passed ..00.00.25

VOICE
Allen had been at Limelight - a popular Krugersdorp nightspot. Kariska was told that Allen had been allegedly causing trouble and was forcibly removed by a bouncer and died outside the front entrance to the pub.

UP SOUND: KARISKA
00.02.13 if he caused trouble like all of them say they could have handled the situation better .. took him out OF THE CLUb closed the doors maybe. phoned the saps if he still wanted to come in … close doors, saps.. take him away it not necessary to hit him …
… it was not necessary to to kill him they could have handled the situation better 00.02.48



VOICE:
The bouncer was named as Allan Trollip a part time employee.

Wilma Sammons, The owner of Limelight considers that the bouncer was simply doing his job.

UP SOUND WILMA: 001
Mr Alan Trollip stood with his back to the door, Mr Eksteen came and grabbed him again around his neck to try and strangle him. So all that I think that could have happened was that he maybe gave him a shove-punch so he fell, and maybe fell out of the door and got injured.

Mr Eksteen was still alive for round about and hour and a half, where he laid on his side outside the door, where I stood and saw that he was still alive.


VOICE:
When the ambulance arrived Allen Eksteen was declared dead, leaving his young family without a breadwinner and a daddy.


00_0026_2015-10-09_120008
UP SOUND: KARISKA 00.00.47 the only way I could say nicely to them … is that your father was assaulted he is dead .. no longer here ..
DEVI LINK: BOUNCERS AND PATRONS HAVE THE SAME RIGHTS .. SO WHY DO SOME BOUNCERS FEEL THEY HAVE THE RIGHT TO USE EXCESSIVE FORCE

VOICE: At Cool Runnings in Benoni Bouncers ended the 30th birthday celebrations of Graeme Bedford and his friends. They arrived at 2am to find the venue closed in compliance with the liquor law and so they were denied drinks. Arguments followed. Graeme claims he was knocked unconscious by the bouncers.

UP SOUND: GRAEME
00.07.32
I seen one of my friends on the floor, friends screamed HE HAD BEEN HIT .. as I stood up .. I was attacked, hit by bouncer and knocked unconscious .. from what I was told hit once .. and kicked a few times on the floor.
UP SOUND: GRAEME
The next morning I found out that a few of my friends who were there that night were trying to get us out and were also assaulted so a total of us …


VOICE:
The owner of Cool Runnings – George Harito says his bouncers are contracted through an agency. His side of the story states that Graeme and his three friends attacked and beat up his bouncers.

UP SOUND GEORGE HARITO OWNER OF COOL RUNNINGS
“They started an argument in the parking lot and the bouncers broke that up. The one gent in particular took his shirt off and started attacking the bouncer. 0.23.31

DEVI: THERE WERE VERY SERIOUS INJURIES ..

GEORGE HARITO 00.23.44 there was very serious injuries .. and by all means no one condones that …. and there is a brotherhood amongst bouncers … cos at end of day they just coming here to do their graft …


Voiceover:
But nightclub owners are misguided if they believe they are not responsible for the actions of their bouncers. Clubs can still be held liable if the bouncers are their permanent employees.

UPSOUND: LAWYER TITLE HER AS WEBBER WENTZEL
00.02.49 when you employ somebody you effectively choosing that person to be your hands. Instead of doing it yourself you are enabling them to do it for you. So that means you have to take the responsibly of the risk that you have created .. by unleashing that person on the public. you have to take responsibility for their actions. 00.03.27



Voice:
Webber Wentzel Lawyer Otrabea Ampofo-Anti
explains that these acts can’t be fobbed off by someone saying they are doing their job.

UP SOUND:
00.02.11 If you have hired a bouncer and put them at door and you have actually given them the authority to be in charge of of security at your establishment … you will have to take responsible through vicarious liability for their unlawful and wrongful actions … that means anyone they kill you could potentially face a claim for damages by their family 00.02.38

VOICE:
However, Vicarious liability does not pertain to those employed as freelancers by a club. The individual facts of each case would determine liability.

UP SOUND: Wilma
I AM NOT GOING TO SAY I AM RESPONSIBLE …BECAUSE FIRSTLY HE WALKED IN HERE AND MADE TROUBLE. AND ALL I CAN SAY IS THAT I AM SORRY …ALL I CAN SAY IS SORRY BUT I CAN’T TAKE RESPONSIBILITY …
DEVI LINK OUTSIDE COOL RUNNINGS:
WHAT I AM BATTLING TO UNDERSTAND IS HOW THIS GETS TO so out of hand, it starts with a skirmish and ends with people in hospital and sometimes even death.

GENE: 00.41.40 I think it should be regulated … PEOPLE should be trained to be a so-called bouncer … … with their name tag on … .. registered with an authority like security Industry regulation authority’

UP SOUND: STEFAN
00.07.40if you are rendering the security service .. you are protecting people or property at these clubs or venues .. you need to ensure you are legally registered with us ..

VOICE:
Stefan Badenhorst from PSIRA the Security Industry Regulatory Authority states that criteria for registration include: South African citizenship; screening for convictions and passing the correct training courses.

UP SOUND: STEFAN
00.06.30 if a bouncer is not registered with PSIRA is that an offence
00.06.37 yes they commit a criminal offence, our law says they must be registered. if not then they are committing offence in terms of the act … A Successful conviction can be 5 years imprisonment or appropriate fine and a subsequent can be up to 10 and years imprisonment .

VOICE: Okoochooku Joshua Nywiro is out on bail and will be back in court mid January to face charges for the killing of Shane BarakoVitz.

Allen Trollip was arrested and detained the day after Allen Eksteen’s death. He was charged with one count of Murder. The charges were provisionally withdrawn pending the finalisation of the investigation.

Graeme Bedford’s attackers still remain unidentified.

UP SOUND: Graeme Bedford if we go out I am looking over my shoulder if the bouncers are around

00_0026_2015-10-09_120008
KARISKA
00.010.53 no one knows how hard it is .. .until it happens to you 00.11.00
JAQUI
I would rather swap my life now and be alive .. he had so much to do in his life and for no reason someone taken his life 00.13.36

metadata.Summary: Deaths by bouncers - unnecessary and horrific. They should go through training. When does one intervene? Do steroids play a major role?
metadata.Further information: In the week that SA released it's crime stats and announced that murder was up by 4.9% a young 23 year old was stabbed and kicked in the head by a bouncer at a Pretoria nightclub. His traumatised brother witnessed the attack and recorded it. The family hired a private investigator to track down the bouncer in the cell phone footage and he did. The private investigator will speak to us. He knows a great deal about the case including that there were two bouncers involved. The first bouncer stabbed Shane and the second bouncer kicked him in the head. His death certificate says he died from a head wound. The bouncer who stabbed him is still at large. We may be able to use photographs of the bouncer. This happened in the car park of the Menlyn Square Shopping Centre outside the club. I am still waiting for an opening to talk to the family as it has only been a few days but the PI all take me to visit the father. We are also hoping to get witnesses and a statement from the police. The patrons told the venue to lock the place down but the venue refused. The police also asked patrons not to make trouble for Tys Nightclub. This is the third incident in a month at this nightclub. There has been an attempted rape and an assault in the last three weeks. There is a chance that the other two victims will speak on camera but will be disguised. The owner of the nightclub hires huge guys to act as bouncers but they have no training or background checks done. The Private Investigator will speak about these other cases and is trying to persuade the other two victims to come on camera albeit anonymously. A month ago a young father was killed in a bar in Krugersdorp. Cell phone footage shows the drunk patron being taken outside by the bouncer and around the corner of the pub. The bouncer returns but the patron is lying dead. The owner of the bar says the bouncer was just doing his job. Patrons say that the police did not take any statements and asked witnesses to go home and let them do their job. One of my experts is a A former bouncer and nightclub owner for 18 years says that there are two sides to the story. Patrons often get drunk or are taking drugs and often the bouncer is the last resort to intervene. But he says it is out of control now and that steroids are playing a bigger role than normal..He says it is used to be really hard to get them but now they are being sold in many gyms. He promises that if we promise to protect his anonymity he will spill the beans about the bouncer situation in JHB and Pretoria. I am waiting to confirm a specialist who will speak about what the side effects of these steroids are. I have not yet contacted Mike Bolhuis - I am unsure if I need him at this stage.
